static func _hdist(q0: int, r0: int, q1: int, r1: int) -> int:
	var dq := q0 - q1
	var dr := r0 - r1
	return int((absi(dq) + absi(dq + dr) + absi(dr)) / 2)


# one mesh with the outer edge of every patch of terrain, objective zone and the well's rim and pull rings: a thin line
# and a soft band fading inward, coloured by kind; how strong it shows is the look's terrain_edge
func _terrain_edges() -> void:
	edges = MeshInstance3D.new()
	edges.name = "TerrainEdges"
	var em := LS.material(true)
	edges.material_override = em
	edges.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	add_child(edges)
	var groups := {}
	var T: Dictionary = VW.get("terrain", {})
	for k in T:
		var t := str(T[k])
		if t == "hulk" or t == "station":
			t = "rock"
		if EDGE_C.has(t) and index.has(k):
			if not groups.has(t):
				groups[t] = {}
			groups[t][k] = true
	for k in zone_of:
		var z := str(zone_of[k])
		if not groups.has(z):
			groups[z] = {}
		groups[z][k] = true
	var o = VW.get("obj")
	if o is Dictionary and str(o.get("type", "")) == "hold" and o.get("hex") is Dictionary:
		groups["hold"] = {key(o["hex"]["q"], o["hex"]["r"]): true}
	var meta = VW.get("map")
	if well_c != Vector3.INF and meta is Dictionary:
		var wq := int(meta["deadstar"]["q"])
		var wr := int(meta["deadstar"]["r"])
		groups["rim"] = {}
		groups["pull"] = {}
		for h in cells:
			var d := _hdist(h.q, h.r, wq, wr)
			if d <= 3:
				groups["rim"][key(h.q, h.r)] = true
			if d <= 5:
				groups["pull"][key(h.q, h.r)] = true
	# step 2: the natural terrain (nebula, ion storm, debris, rock) gets its own edge mesh, so look C can drop those hex
	# outlines (the gas, wrecks and rocks themselves show where they are) and the tactical grid still brings them back;
	# objective zones and the dead star's rings keep theirs
	gas_edges = MeshInstance3D.new()
	gas_edges.name = "GasEdges"
	gas_edges.material_override = em.duplicate()
	gas_edges.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	add_child(gas_edges)
	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	var sg := SurfaceTool.new()
	sg.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	var n := 0
	var ng := 0
	for g in groups:
		if g == "debris" or g == "rock":
			continue   # issue 1359: solid_edges and cover_edges draw these, in Z and on hover
		if g == "neb" or g == "storm":
			ng += _edge_into(sg, groups[g], EDGE_C[g])
		else:
			n += _edge_into(st, groups[g], EDGE_C[g])
	edges.mesh = st.commit() if n > 0 else null
	gas_edges.mesh = sg.commit() if ng > 0 else null
	hazard_edges = MeshInstance3D.new()
	hazard_edges.name = "HazardEdges"
	hazard_edges.material_override = em.duplicate()
	hazard_edges.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	add_child(hazard_edges)
	var sz := SurfaceTool.new()
	sz.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	var nz := 0
	for g in HAZARD_EDGE:
		if groups.has(g):
			nz += _edge_into(sz, groups[g], EDGE_C[g])
	hazard_edges.mesh = sz.commit() if nz > 0 else null
	# Issue 1359: solid ground includes the map's set-piece holes, which are never board cells
	var solid: Dictionary = (groups.get("rock", {}) as Dictionary).duplicate()
	if meta is Dictionary:
		for hole in meta.get("holes", []):
			if str(hole.get("kind", "")) == "deadstar": continue
			for cell in hole.get("cells", []): solid[key(int(cell[0]), int(cell[1]))] = true
	var cover: Dictionary = groups.get("debris", {})
	solid_edges = _edge_mesh(self, "SolidEdges", em, solid, SOLID_EDGE_C)
	cover_edges = _edge_mesh(self, "CoverEdges", em, cover, EDGE_C["debris"])
	hover_edges = Node3D.new()
	hover_edges.name = "HoverEdges"
	add_child(hover_edges)
	_hover_patch = {}
	_hover_shown = null
	for kind in ["solid", "cover"]:
		var keys: Dictionary = solid if kind == "solid" else cover
		for patch in _patches_of(keys):
			var mi := _edge_mesh(hover_edges, kind, em, patch, SOLID_EDGE_C if kind == "solid" else EDGE_C["debris"])
			mi.visible = false
			for k in patch: _hover_patch[k] = mi


# connected groups of hex keys (six neighbours)
func _patches_of(keys: Dictionary) -> Array:
	var out: Array = []
	var seen := {}
	for k0 in keys:
		if seen.has(k0): continue
		var patch := {}
		var todo: Array = [k0]
		seen[k0] = true
		while not todo.is_empty():
			var k: String = str(todo.pop_back())
			patch[k] = true
			var qr: PackedStringArray = k.split(",")
			for d in [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1], [1, -1], [-1, 1]]:
				var nk := key(int(qr[0]) + int(d[0]), int(qr[1]) + int(d[1]))
				if keys.has(nk) and not seen.has(nk):
					seen[nk] = true
					todo.append(nk)
		out.append(patch)
	return out


# issue 1359: the normal view shows the rim of the solid or debris patch under the cursor only
func _show_hover_edge(raw: String) -> void:
	var mi: MeshInstance3D = _hover_patch.get(raw) if _edge_hover else null
	if mi == _hover_shown: return
	if is_instance_valid(_hover_shown): _hover_shown.visible = false
	_hover_shown = mi
	if mi != null:
		(mi.material_override as ShaderMaterial).set_shader_parameter("gain", float(_hover_gain.get(str(mi.get_meta("edge_kind")), 0.0)))
		mi.visible = fills == null or fills.visible


func _edge_mesh(parent: Node, nm: String, em: ShaderMaterial, keys: Dictionary, col: Color) -> MeshInstance3D:
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	mi.name = nm
	mi.set_meta("edge_kind", nm)
	mi.material_override = em.duplicate()
	mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	parent.add_child(mi)
	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	mi.mesh = st.commit() if _edge_into(st, keys, col) > 0 else null
	return mi


# the outer edges of a set of hexes into a SurfaceTool, drawn with the shared line style (render/line_style.gd, issue
# 1374): the line sits just inside the outer hex edge and its glow band runs inward; col is the role's colour and strength
func _edge_into(st: SurfaceTool, keys: Dictionary, col: Color, y := -0.36) -> int:
	var corners: Array = []
	for i in 6:
		var an := deg_to_rad(60.0 * i + 30.0)
		corners.append(Vector3(cos(an), 0, sin(an)))
	var n := 0
	var r0 := HS * 0.97
	for k in keys:
		var qr: PackedStringArray = str(k).split(",")
		var c := hex_world(int(qr[0]), int(qr[1]), y)
		for i in 6:
			var a: Vector3 = corners[i]
			var b: Vector3 = corners[(i + 1) % 6]
			var nb := world_hex(c + (a + b) * 0.5 * HS * 2.0)
			if keys.has(key(nb.x, nb.y)):
				continue
			n += 1
			# toward the centre along the corner spokes, scaled so one unit along them is one unit in from the edge
			LS.strip_into(st, c + a * r0, c + b * r0, -a / 0.8660254, -b / 0.8660254, "edge", col)
	return n

func _unhandled_input(e: InputEvent) -> void:
	if fills == null or not fills.visible or ModalFocus.any_open():

func _rock_lib() -> Array:
	var man = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string("res://gen/manifest.json")) if FileAccess.file_exists("res://gen/manifest.json") else null
	var set_name := "RST"
	var biome = WI.get("biome")
	if biome is Dictionary and HT.ROCK_SET.has(biome.get("rock", "")):
		set_name = HT.ROCK_SET[biome["rock"]]
	var out: Array = []
	if man is Dictionary:
		for code in man["rocks"]:
			if man["rocks"][code]["set"] == set_name:
				out.append(load(man["rocks"][code]["res"]))
	return out


func _terrain() -> void:
	base_fill.clear()
	rock_meshes = _rock_lib()
	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	rng.seed = int(WI.get("seed", 1)) if WI.get("seed") != null else 1
	var T: Dictionary = VW.get("terrain", {})
	for k in T:
		var typ: String = T[k]
		var qr: PackedStringArray = k.split(",")
		var q := int(qr[0])
		var r := int(qr[1])
		var c := hex_world(q, r)
		if ZONE_TINT.has(typ):
			base_fill[k] = ZONE_TINT[typ]
		match typ:
			"rock":
				if not props_world:
					_rocks(c, rng, 3 + rng.randi() % 3, 2.5, 6.5)
			"hulk":
				_rocks(c, rng, 2, 1.5, 3.0)
				_hulk(c, rng)
			"debris":
				if not props_world:
					_rocks(c, rng, 5, 0.5, 1.4)
			"station":
				pass
	_planet()
	_beacon()
	# one station structure per cluster of station hexes (the game builds one across the cluster)
	var seen := {}
	for k in T:
		if T[k] != "station" or seen.has(k):
			continue
		var stack := [k]
		var cl: Array = []
		seen[k] = true
		while not stack.is_empty():
			var cur: String = stack.pop_back()
			cl.append(cur)
			var qr: PackedStringArray = cur.split(",")
			for d in [[1, 0], [0, 1], [-1, 1], [-1, 0], [0, -1], [1, -1]]:
				var nk := key(int(qr[0]) + d[0], int(qr[1]) + d[1])
				if T.get(nk, "") == "station" and not seen.has(nk):
					seen[nk] = true
					stack.append(nk)
		var cen := Vector3.ZERO
		var centres: Array[Vector3] = []
		for ck in cl:
			var qr2: PackedStringArray = ck.split(",")
			var p := hex_world(int(qr2[0]), int(qr2[1]))
			centres.append(p)
			cen += p
		cen /= float(cl.size())
		var clearance := HS
		for p in centres:
			clearance = maxf(clearance, cen.distance_to(p) + HS)
		var size := STATION_BIG_LEN if cl.size() >= STATION_BIG_HEXES else STATION_BASE_LEN + STATION_PER_HEX * cl.size()
		var teaching: bool = cl.size() == 3 and VW.get("map", {}).get("stationR", 0) == 1
		_station(cen, rng, size, teaching, clearance)


# Issue 1582 item 4: a few small loose fragments ride above and below the plane round each rock and debris hex, so a
# fleet threads through a field with depth. They never block (the rules' rock stays the hex's core on the plane), stay
# inside their own hex's footprint so no hex beside them looks taken, and use their own seed so the board's other random
# draws do not shift. A look only.
const FRAG_Y := [4.0, 9.0]     # height off the plane, up or down (world units)
const FRAG_S := [0.45, 1.25]   # fragment size
var depth_frags: Node3D


func _depth_fragments() -> void:
	if depth_frags != null and is_instance_valid(depth_frags):
		depth_frags.queue_free()
	depth_frags = Node3D.new()
	depth_frags.name = "fx_depth_fragments"
	add_child(depth_frags)
	var T: Dictionary = VW.get("terrain", {}) if VW.get("terrain") is Dictionary else {}
	var biome = WI.get("biome")
	var rock_kind := str(biome.get("rock", "stone")) if biome is Dictionary else "stone"
	var names: Array = BV.WR.names_for(rock_kind)
	if names.is_empty():
		return
	# the same procedural rocks and finish the world's blockers use (world/blocker_visuals.gd), so the chips match
	var mat: ShaderMaterial = BV.WR.material(rock_kind, {"haze_max": 0.0})
	mat.set_shader_parameter("lift", 1.2)
	mat.set_shader_parameter("amb", 0.65)
	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	rng.seed = hash("depth|%s" % str(WI.get("seed", 1)))
	var keys: Array = T.keys()
	keys.sort()
	for k in keys:
		var typ: String = T[k]
		if typ != "rock" and typ != "debris":
			continue
		var qr: PackedStringArray = str(k).split(",")
		var c := hex_world(int(qr[0]), int(qr[1]))
		for i in (3 if typ == "rock" else 2):
			var mesh_name := str(names[rng.randi() % names.size()])
			var a := rng.randf() * TAU
			var rad := rng.randf_range(1.5, HS * 0.55)
			var y := rng.randf_range(FRAG_Y[0], FRAG_Y[1]) * (1.0 if rng.randf() < 0.55 else -0.8)
			var mi := BV.cluster_piece(depth_frags, BV.WR.mesh(mesh_name), mat, c + Vector3(cos(a) * rad, y, sin(a) * rad), rng.randf_range(FRAG_S[0], FRAG_S[1]), rng)
			mi.name = "frag_" + mesh_name
			var box := (mi.mesh as Mesh).get_aabb()
			mi.set_instance_shader_parameter("rock_radius", box.position.abs().max(box.end.abs()).length())
			mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF


func _rocks(c: Vector3, rng: RandomNumberGenerator, n: int, s0: float, s1: float) -> void:
	if rock_meshes.is_empty():

# reads as the relay the fleets fight over. Picture only: the rules place nothing there and ships still end their moves on
# the hex above it. It sits below the board plane (its top under the grid), so a ship holding the hex floats over it, and its
# lens is turned toward the player's side of the board and tipped up, so the blue rings read from the battle camera.
const BEACON_LEN := 12.0      # O3's length_world 7.5 times the board's ship scale (hull_table SHIP_K 1.6)
const BEACON_TOP := -0.6      # the highest point of the beacon, just under the grid
const BEACON_TILT := 35.0     # degrees the lens is tipped up from level
# Ryan's 1536B look (Nov 22, "Lift it onto the hex"): under the grid, the beacon slid to the near edge of its hex from the
# battle camera. Its middle now sits on the sightline from the camera's opening (home) eye through the hex centre, so the
# player sees it centred in the gold hex at the opening view while its top stays under the grid (Artoo on PR 1561: a real
# perspective sightline, not a fixed z shift, so a hold hex off the camera's axis centres too).
const BEACON_VIEW_B := 0.98   # camera_rig home_b: the home view's angle from straight up
var beacon_node: Node3D = null


func _beacon() -> void:
	beacon_node = null
	var o = VW.get("obj")

		return
	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
	var n := A4P.beacon(BEACON_LEN)
	if n == null:
		return
	print("[board] relay beacon ready in %.1f ms (threaded prefetch collected, issue 1536)" % ((Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0) / 1000.0))
	# lens (+x) toward +z (the player's side, where the battle camera starts), then tipped up by BEACON_TILT
	var basis := Basis(Vector3.RIGHT, -deg_to_rad(BEACON_TILT)) * Basis(Vector3.UP, -PI / 2.0)
	var box := AABB()
	var first := true
	for mi in n.find_children("*", "MeshInstance3D", true, false):
		var xf := Transform3D(basis, Vector3.ZERO) * _rel_to(mi as Node3D, n)
		var bb: AABB = xf * (mi as MeshInstance3D).get_aabb()
		box = bb if first else box.merge(bb)
		first = false
	var drop := BEACON_TOP - box.end.y              # the top just under the grid
	var depth := -(box.get_center().y + drop)       # how far the beacon's middle sits under the grid
	var h := hex_world(float(o["hex"]["q"]), float(o["hex"]["r"]), 0.0)
	var eye := home_eye(VW.get("units", []))
	var mid := h + (h - eye) * (depth / maxf(eye.y, 1.0))   # on the sightline from the eye through h, depth under the grid

# The battle camera's opening view (scenes/battle/battle.gd _begin uses this): it looks at a point 30% of the way from the
# player's fleet centre to the enemy's, from home_r away (the fleets' distance * 0.75, 130 to 210).
func home_view(units: Array) -> Dictionary:
	var pc := Vector3.ZERO
	var ec := Vector3.ZERO
	var np := 0
	var ne := 0
	for u in units:
		if str(u.get("side", "")) == "player":
			pc += hex_world(u["q"], u["r"])
			np += 1
		else:
			ec += hex_world(u["q"], u["r"])
			ne += 1
	pc /= maxf(1.0, np)
	ec = ec / maxf(1.0, ne) if ne > 0 else pc
	var target := pc.lerp(ec, 0.3)
	target.y = 0.0
	return {"target": target, "r": clampf(pc.distance_to(ec) * 0.75, 130.0, 210.0)}


# the camera's eye at the opening view (camera_rig _apply at a = -PI/2, b = home_b)
func home_eye(units: Array) -> Vector3:
	var hv := home_view(units)
	return (hv["target"] as Vector3) + Vector3(0.0, cos(BEACON_VIEW_B), sin(BEACON_VIEW_B)) * float(hv["r"])


# a node's transform relative to an ancestor (before either is in the tree)
static func _rel_to(node: Node3D, ancestor: Node) -> Transform3D:
	var xf := Transform3D.IDENTITY
	var p: Node = node
	while p != null and p != ancestor:
		if p is Node3D:
			xf = (p as Node3D).transform * xf
		p = p.get_parent()
	return xf

func add_wreck(id: String, q: int, r: int, hull := false) -> void:
	var k := key(q, r)

	var behind := _view(world, "Frigate", -2.4, Vector3.ZERO)
	var bp: Vector3 = cam.global_position + ray * t_lo
	behind.position = Vector3(bp.x, 0, bp.z)
	var front := _view(world, "Frigate", 3.6, Vector3.ZERO)
	var t_hi := (cam.global_position.y - 3.6) / -ray.y   # in front of the capital, 3.6 up, on the same ray
	var fp: Vector3 = cam.global_position + ray * t_hi
	front.position = Vector3(fp.x, 0, fp.z)
	front.visible = false
	battle.views = {"cap": cap, "behind": behind, "front": front}
	battle.VU = {"cap": {"id": "cap", "q": 0, "r": 0, "squadron": false}, "behind": {"id": "behind", "q": 5, "r": 1, "squadron": false},
		"front": {"id": "front", "q": 2, "r": 2, "squadron": false}}
	var op: Vector2 = cam.unproject_position(oc)
	check(cam.unproject_position(behind.visual_position()).distance_to(op) < 2.0, "the escort projects onto the capital's middle")
	check(battle._lifted_hull_hex(op).x == 99999, "a lower escort behind a foreground capital does not steal its click")
	front.visible = true
	check(battle._lifted_hull_hex(op) == Vector2i(2, 2), "a raised escort in front of the capital takes the click")
	front.visible = false
	# the band is set in the shared registration every view path calls (opening roster, reinforcement, revive)
	var fresh := SV.new()
	world.add_child(fresh)
	fresh.setup({"id": "fresh", "fac": "hegemony", "cls": "Cruiser", "code": "H9_23", "facing": 0}, Vector3(60, 0, 0))
	battle._register_fx_ship({"id": "fresh", "fac": "hegemony", "cls": "Cruiser", "size": 2, "squadron": false, "flagship": false}, fresh)
	check(is_equal_approx(fresh.band_y, ALT.height({"id": "fresh", "cls": "Cruiser"})) and absf(fresh.band_y) > 0.5, "shared registration sets the band (%.2f)" % fresh.band_y)
	battle._register_fx_ship({"id": "fresh", "fac": "hegemony", "cls": "Cruiser", "size": 2, "squadron": false, "flagship": false}, fresh)
	check(is_equal_approx(fresh.hull.position.y - fresh.hull_lift, fresh.band_y) or absf(fresh.hull_base.y - fresh.band_y) < 0.01, "registering twice keeps the same height")
	battle.free()
	fx.remove_ship("hi")
	fx.remove_ship("lo")
	fx.queue_free()


func _dive(world: Node3D) -> void:
	var fx := FX.new()
	world.add_child(fx)
	fx.manual = true
	fx.setup({"quality": "low", "shake": 0.0})
	var from := Vector3(0, ALT.WING, 0)
	var to := Vector3(60, -2.0, 8)
	fx.dstate["craft_runs"] = []
	FXW._strafe(fx, "fighter", from, to, fx.now, Color.WHITE, {"engine": Color.ORANGE}, 1.0, 1.0, 1, "hegemony")
	var runs: Array = fx.dstate.get("craft_runs", [])
	check(runs.size() == 3, "an attack pass flies three craft")
	if runs.is_empty():
		return
	var r: Dictionary = runs[0]
	var dive: Dictionary = r["dive"]
	check(not dive.is_empty(), "the pass carries its dive")
	var lowest := INF
	var lowest_u := 0.0
	var prev_y := INF
	var down_ok := true
	for k in 81:
		var u := float(k) / 80.0
		var q: Vector3 = FXW._dive_pos(r["a"], r["b"], dive, u)
		if q.y < lowest:
			lowest = q.y
			lowest_u = u
		if u <= float(dive["pi"]) and q.y > prev_y + 1e-4:
			down_ok = false
		prev_y = q.y
	var start_y: float = FXW._dive_pos(r["a"], r["b"], dive, 0.0).y
	var end_y: float = FXW._dive_pos(r["a"], r["b"], dive, 1.0).y
	check(start_y >= ALT.WING - 1.0, "the pass starts at patrol height (%.1f)" % start_y)
	check(down_ok, "it only descends until the low pass")
	check(lowest < to.y + 4.0, "it dives down to the target's height (low %.1f, target %.1f)" % [lowest, to.y])
	check(end_y > lowest + 8.0 and end_y >= ALT.WING - 1.0, "then climbs back out to patrol height (%.1f)" % end_y)
	var fall := start_y - lowest
	var ground: float = Vector2(r["b"].x - r["a"].x, r["b"].z - r["a"].z).length() * lowest_u
	check(fall / maxf(ground, 1.0) > 0.12 and _steepest(r) > 0.6, "the dive is steep enough to read (drop %.1f over %.1f, steepest %.2f)" % [fall, ground, _steepest(r)])
	# the craft node pitches nose down in the dive and up in the climb
	fx.dstate["craft_runs"] = [r]
	r["t0"] = fx.now
	var node: Node3D = r["node"]
	var pitches: Array = []
	var pi_u := float(dive["pi"])
	for u in [(float(dive["pd"]) + pi_u) * 0.5, (pi_u + float(dive["pc"])) * 0.5]:
		fx.now = float(r["t0"]) + float(r["life"]) * u
		FXW._craft_update(fx, 0.0)
		pitches.append(node.basis.x.normalized().y)
	check(float(pitches[0]) < -0.05 and float(pitches[1]) > 0.05, "the craft pitch down into the dive and up out of it (%.2f, %.2f)" % pitches)
	for rr in runs:
		if is_instance_valid(rr["node"]):
			(rr["node"] as Node).queue_free()
	fx.dstate["craft_runs"] = []
	# a level pass (wing and target at the same height) keeps a shallow run
	FXW._strafe(fx, "fighter", Vector3(0, 0, 0), Vector3(60, 0, 0), fx.now, Color.WHITE, {"engine": Color.ORANGE}, 1.0, 1.0, 1, "hegemony")
	var lr: Dictionary = fx.dstate["craft_runs"][0]
	var drop_lvl: float = FXW._dive_pos(lr["a"], lr["b"], lr["dive"], 0.0).y - FXW._dive_pos(lr["a"], lr["b"], lr["dive"], float(lr["dive"]["pi"])).y
	check(drop_lvl < 3.0, "a level pass stays shallow (%.1f)" % drop_lvl)
	for rr in fx.dstate["craft_runs"]:
		(rr["node"] as Node).queue_free()
	fx.dstate["craft_runs"] = []
	# torpedoes fly straight between heights: never above the higher end (issue 1713 holds between bands)
	var fac := {"engine": Color(1.0, 0.6, 0.3)}
	for ends in [[Vector3(0, 4.5, 0), Vector3(70, -2.4, 10)], [Vector3(0, -2.4, 0), Vector3(70, 4.5, -10)]]:
		fx.dstate["proj"] = []
		FXW._launch(fx, "torp", ends[0], Vector3.UP, ends[1], 1.0, 3.0, Color.WHITE, fac, 1.0, 0, false, null, null, 1.0, "hegemony")
		for pr in fx.dstate["proj"]:
			var top := maxf((pr["a"] as Vector3).y, (pr["c"] as Vector3).y) + 0.05
			var peak := -INF
			for s in 41:
				peak = maxf(peak, FXW._bez(pr["a"], pr["b"], pr["c"], float(s) / 40.0).y)
			check(peak <= top, "a torpedo between bands stays flat (peak %.2f, limit %.2f)" % [peak, top])
			check(absf((pr["c"] as Vector3).y - (ends[1] as Vector3).y) < 0.01, "and lands at its target's height")
			if is_instance_valid(pr["mesh"]):
				(pr["mesh"] as Node).queue_free()
	fx.dstate["proj"] = []
	fx.queue_free()


# the steepest downward slope of the dive (drop per ground unit)
func _steepest(r: Dictionary) -> float:
	var best := 0.0
	var prev: Vector3 = FXW._dive_pos(r["a"], r["b"], r["dive"], 0.0)
	for k in range(1, 201):
		var q: Vector3 = FXW._dive_pos(r["a"], r["b"], r["dive"], float(k) / 200.0)
		var g := Vector2(q.x - prev.x, q.z - prev.z).length()
		if g > 1e-4:
			best = maxf(best, (prev.y - q.y) / g)
		prev = q
	return best


func _personalities() -> void:
	var styles := {}
	var igns := {}
	for f in ["voidsworn", "hegemony", "corsair", "ithar", "chorus", "deathless"]:
		check(TP.TABLE.has(f), f + " has a thrust personality")
		var p := TP.of(f)
		styles[f] = p["style"]
		igns[f] = float(p["ign"])
	check(styles["chorus"] == "pulse" and styles["deathless"] == "ripple" and styles["ithar"] == "glint", "Chorus, Eclipse and the Glasswrights throw no gas")
	check(igns["voidsworn"] > igns["hegemony"] and igns["hegemony"] > igns["deathless"] and igns["corsair"] < igns["hegemony"], "Sunward spools slowest, Hullbreakers kick, Eclipse is all but instant")
	check(int(TP.of("corsair")["sparks"]) > 0 and int(TP.of("hegemony")["sparks"]) == 0, "only the Hullbreakers throw grit")
	var sig := {}
	for f in TP.TABLE:
		var p := TP.of(f)
		sig[str([p["style"], p["ign"], p["size"], p["life"], p["spread"], p["speed"]])] = true
	check(sig.size() == 6, "six distinct signatures")
	# the ignition beat follows the profile on a real flown move
	var world := Node3D.new()
	root.add_child(world)
	var beats := {}
	for f in ["voidsworn", "hegemony", "deathless"]:
		var sv := SV.new()
		world.add_child(sv)
		sv.setup({"id": "ign_" + f, "fac": f, "cls": "Cruiser", "code": "H9_23", "facing": 0}, Vector3.ZERO)
		sv.set_process(false)
		sv.play_glide([{"kind": "run", "p": Vector3(17.3, 0, 0)}, {"kind": "run", "p": Vector3(34.6, 0, 0)}], 0.5, {"mass": 0.6})
		beats[f] = float(sv.gl_ign_u)
	check(beats["voidsworn"] > beats["hegemony"] and beats["hegemony"] > beats["deathless"], "a flown move's ignition beat follows the faction (%s)" % str(beats))
	world.queue_free()


func _run() -> void:
	var world := Node3D.new()
	root.add_child(world)
	var man := {"ships": {"H9_23": {"res": fixture()}}}
	SV._manifest = man
	_bands()
	_drop(world)
	_dive(world)
	_personalities()
	await process_frame
	world.queue_free()
	await process_frame
	SV.clear_static()
	print("STAGE2 %s: %d checks, %d failures" % ["PASS" if fails == 0 else "FAIL", checks, fails])
	quit(1 if fails > 0 else 0)
